summary: Main Campground checked on the park's camping page, campground map and nine two-week windows of the reservation calendar: 52 sites, 20/30 A + water, sewer on 1-4, rigs 21-40 ft (ADA 51-52 to 84 ft); $32-34 base, $42-47 sewer sites, $52/$65 on holiday weekends; year-round; lakeview kept (sites ~55-80 m back through woods, ~12 m above pool); stored pin is ~950 m off, at the visitor-center/cabin area.
